# Codexnovas

> Codexnovas is a premier digital product studio specializing in web development, mobile application engineering, custom AI solutions, and scalable software design.

## Brand Overview
- **Official Name**: Codexnovas
- **Legal Name**: Codexnovas
- **Official Website**: https://codexnovas.in
- **Tagline**: Digital Product Studio | Web, App & AI Development

## Core Services & Solutions
- **Web Development**: Scalable, high-performance web applications built using Next.js, React, and modern UI frameworks.
- **Mobile App Development**: Cross-platform mobile applications engineered with Flutter and React Native.
- **AI & Automation**: Machine learning integration, custom AI chatbots, process automation, and intelligent software workflows.
- **Enterprise Software**: End-to-end custom software solutions, backend APIs (Spring Boot, Node.js), and cloud architecture.
